# Manager, Systems Engineering (DCL New Build) — Disney Signature Experiences

---
**Job ID:** 10160198
**Date Posted:** Sep 24, 2026
**Date Applied:** Sep 24, 2026
**Salary Range:** $135,200–$181,200 per year — Celebration, FL (primarily on-site; 10% travel)
---

## Job Summary

A manager role leading Technical Project Managers and Engineers who deploy, integrate, automate, validate, and commission shipboard applications for Disney Cruise Line's New Build ships. The manager drives an automation-first deployment and commissioning approach from initial concept through maiden voyage, partners with Systems Engineering and SRE (including a dotted-line relationship with SRE engineers building deployment tooling), and balances technology and business priorities across New Build capital efforts.

---

## What You'll Do

- Lead, mentor, and grow Technical Project Managers, and partner with Systems Engineers on application deployment, integration, and commissioning.
- Oversee application integration across New Ship Build projects so systems work as one platform.
- Provide governance over application implementation, aligned with delivery milestones and the maiden voyage timeline.
- Lead the design of an automation-first deployment pipeline strategy.
- Guide installation of operating systems, databases, and utility software, and represent New Build in systems and infrastructure design.
- Translate organizational goals into outcomes and roadmaps with product, application, and business teams.
- Oversee New Build financials, including forecasting, accruals, and cost optimization.
- Act as technical liaison across Disney Cruise Line, Walt Disney Imagineering, vendors, and international stakeholders.
- Drive simplification and standardization through infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, scripting, and emerging technologies, with a platform-engineering mindset.
- Advise external partners on delivery strategy, brief executives on risks and tradeoffs, and serve as an escalation point for application readiness.
- Develop resource plans for new ships and hand off smoothly to operational teams.

### Required Qualifications
- Minimum 8 years of related technology experience, with 3+ years leading projects across diverse technical and business teams
- Automation and infrastructure tooling (Ansible, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, configuration management, CI/CD)
- Guiding system or infrastructure architecture, including scalability, performance, and security
- Persuasive leadership across a matrixed organization, vendors, and customers
- Problem-solving and accountability for team delivery
- Managing technology budgets, including forecasting and accruals
- Agile or similar delivery with cross-functional teams
- Managing projects with multiple vendors, including offshore teams
- Scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and Git workflows
- Exposure to AI-assisted development, testing, or operations tooling
- Preferred: travel, hospitality, or cruise industry experience; bias toward emerging tools; managing or partnering with teams building high-volume platforms; cloud or Kubernetes certifications; a Master's degree or equivalent; ship build experience; shipboard or multi-site rollouts; and cybersecurity-by-design frameworks such as IACS E26/E27

### Education
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience.

### Benefits
A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be included, along with a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits depending on level and position offered.

### At Application — Sep 24, 2026

- **Leadership tenure fits:** the record covers engineering and technology work from 2015 (RJB.Engineering) and 2016 (network technician), with project leadership as Lead Electro-Mechanical Engineer, CTO, and Lead R&D Engineer since 2022, meeting the 8-year and 3+-year leadership thresholds.
